messages:
Priya: Heads up — US-west GPU bill for March just landed and it's ~22% over forecast. Seeing a big unallocated chunk (~$18k) under project: ephemeral-runner-01 :eyes:
Anya: Ugh. Is that the new CI autoscale pool? We rolled that out last week, right?
Ben: Yep, autoscale hit a bug where scale-down didn't terminate spots. Looks like retained nodes kept billing. I opened an infra ticket but still investigating.
Luis: Confirmed — we deployed a config change that inadvertently set `min_nodes: 2` for the spot pool in us-west. Repro: `kubectl get hpa -n infra-autoscale` and the controller kept trying to keep pods on leftover nodes.
Priya: Ok can we tag those historical runs so finance can reassign? Current reports show `unlabeled` which kills our CGPU allocation.
Ben: I'll run a backfill script to add tags based on instance names. Quick query I'm going to use in BigQuery (cost export):
```
SELECT resource.labels.instance_id, project.id, cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export.clusters_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03' AND labels.autoscale_pool = 'ephemeral-runner-01'
```
I'll push results to a shared sheet.
Anya: If we can get that within the day we can adjust team budgets before payroll cutoffs. Finance, any playbook for reallocating retro charges?
finance-bot: FYI — cost reclassification window is 30 days. Submit `#finance` ticket with CSV of (instance_id, owner_team, amount) and include invoice id. Automated process will apply adjustments to next internal chargeback run.
Priya: @finance-bot thanks. Filing ticket now and attaching the sheet when Ben posts it. Also thinking: can we request a one-time prepay credit from our cloud vendor for these orphan charges?
CFO-Bot: Alert: Prepay/commit increases risk to liquidity. If savings > $25k and a clear recurring pattern, escalate to finance leadership. Otherwise proceed with reclassification.
Luis: For immediate mitigation, I disabled the `min_nodes` override and added a guard in the autoscale controller. Patch: `git rev 3a7f` in infra-autoscale.
Ben: Backfill script started — ETA ~3h. Will ping when CSV ready. :thumbsup:
Anya: Great, after backfill let's run an internal report to see which product teams hit their alert thresholds and update budgets.
Priya: Thanks team. Action items: Ben -> CSV + sheet, Priya -> finance ticket, Luis -> confirm controller fix, Anya -> update budget alerts.
Ben: Pinged the sheet: https://redwood-internal/sheets/3k9g (read-only for now).
finance-bot: Noted. Ticket #FIN-2026-483 opened for reclass request — attach CSV and invoice id to proceed.
Priya: Closing loop once the ticket is complete. If anything else pops up I’ll post here. :white_check_mark:
